Name: Flip-Flop
Inspect text: One lonely foam sandal. Light, bendy, never breaks down.

Name: Shopping Bag
Inspect text: A thin, crinkly bag, still bobbing with trapped air.

Name: Rubber Duck
Inspect text: Squeaks when you squeeze it. Hollow, moulded, cheerful.

Name: Milk Crate
Inspect text: A sturdy moulded crate. The dairy logo is barely legible.

Name: Soda Can
Inspect text: Crushed flat. It clinks against the tray.

Name: Rusty Bike Chain
Inspect text: Links fused together with orange rust.

Name: Tin Bucket
Inspect text: Dented, with a wire handle. Someone's bait bucket once.

Name: Hubcap
Inspect text: A chrome wheel cover, surprisingly heavy for its size.

Name: Shopping Cart
Inspect text: How did this even get out here? A whole wire frame of it.

Name: Glass Bottle
Inspect text: Empty, clear, and cold. No message inside, sadly.

Name: Jam Jar
Inspect text: The label washed off long ago. You can see right through it.

Name: Sea Glass
Inspect text: A frosted shard, tumbled smooth by the tide.

Name: Fishbowl
Inspect text: A round, see-through bowl. Its fish is long gone.

Name: Driftwood
Inspect text: A bleached, twisty branch. Grain still shows through.

Name: Broken Oar
Inspect text: Half an oar, snapped at the shaft. Varnish peeling.

Name: Crate Plank
Inspect text: A stencilled board from a shipping crate.

Name: Lobster Trap Frame
Inspect text: Slatted and waterlogged. Nothing left of the netting.

Name: Deck Chair
Inspect text: Heavy slats, pegged together. All one material, all soaked.

Name: TV Remote
Inspect text: Buttons, a little circuit board, a battery hatch.

Name: Digital Watch
Inspect text: The screen is blank, but there's a circuit in there.

Name: Solar Garden Light
Inspect text: A little solar panel on a stake, wires trailing out.

Name: Pocket Radio
Inspect text: An antenna, a speaker grille, and water sloshing in the circuitry.

Name: Boombox
Inspect text: Twin speakers and a tape deck. Someone's summer, drowned.

Name: Dead Batteries
Inspect text: A handful of corroded cells, leaking something crusty. Handle with care.

Name: Spent Flare
Inspect text: A burnt-out signal flare. It still smells of chemicals.

Name: Motor Oil Jug
Inspect text: Black sludge coats the inside. Don't let it touch anything.

Name: Paint Tin
Inspect text: Half-full of old marine paint. Toxic stuff.

Name: Car Battery
Inspect text: Heavy, with acid inside. Definitely not going in a normal bin.

Name: Old Sneaker
Inspect text: Rubber sole, fabric upper, metal eyelets. A bit of everything.

Name: Broken Umbrella
Inspect text: Metal ribs, nylon canopy, plastic handle, all tangled together.

Name: Tangled Net
Inspect text: Nylon mesh knotted with rope, floats and lead weights.

Name: Folding Beach Chair
Inspect text: An aluminium frame with striped fabric stretched across it.

Name: Skateboard
Inspect text: A wooden deck on metal trucks, with plastic wheels. Mostly wood, if you could take it apart.

Name: Picture Frame
Inspect text: Gilt-painted wood with brass corners. The glass is long gone.

Name: Snorkel
Inspect text: A bendy tube with a mouthpiece. Light, bright and never rots.

Name: Swim Ring
Inspect text: A deflated ring of shiny stuff. It squeaks when you fold it.

Name: Dive Weight
Inspect text: A small lump on a belt clip. Far heavier than it looks.

Name: Sunglasses
Inspect text: Moulded frames, tinted lenses, little metal hinges.

Name: Circuit Board
Inspect text: Green and gold, with chips soldered on in rows.

Name: Old Monitor
Inspect text: A boxy screen with a coil of cable. Still faintly warm, somehow.

Name: Keyboard
Inspect text: Missing the Q. There's a board of contacts under the keys.

Name: Porthole
Inspect text: A round window: brass ring, thick pane, rubber seal.

Name: Anchor Chain
Inspect text: A heap of huge links, crusted orange. It clanks on the tray.

Name: Handful of Rivets
Inspect text: Fat little studs, all cold and rusty.

Name: Lamp Oil Flask
Inspect text: Black and slick inside. Smells like it would catch.

Name: Diving Helmet
Inspect text: A copper dome with a glass faceplate and leather straps.

Name: Lamp Lens
Inspect text: A ridged, heavy lens. The light comes straight through it.

Name: Signal Lamp
Inspect text: A shuttered lamp with a switch and a tangle of wire.

Name: Keeper's Kettle
Inspect text: Dented and blackened. It rings when you tap it.

Name: Soggy Logbook
Inspect text: Paper pages, a cloth spine and a brass clasp.

Name: Plastic Prize Ring
Inspect text: Gold-coloured, but it bends. From a lucky dip.

Name: Candyfloss Stick
Inspect text: A long, thin stick, still faintly sticky. The grain shows.

Name: Ride Bulb
Inspect text: A coloured bulb from a ride. You can see the filament through it.

Name: Dodgem Battery
Inspect text: A great heavy block of a battery, leaking at one corner.

Name: Life Ring
Inspect text: Orange and white, moulded, light enough to throw.

Name: Ticket Machine
Inspect text: A little printer and a keypad, both dead.

Name: Deck Lantern
Inspect text: Glass sides in a metal cage, with a wick inside.

Name: Bench Slat
Inspect text: A long varnished board. Someone carved their initials in it.

Name: Fishing Float
Inspect text: A little red-and-white bobber. Hollow and moulded.

Name: Wicker Creel
Inspect text: A woven fishing basket. Willow, all of it.

Name: Canoe Paddle
Inspect text: A long carved blade, smoothed by a lot of rivers.

Name: Weedkiller Can
Inspect text: A skull and crossbones on the label. Keep it well away.

Name: Car Tyre
Inspect text: Rubber all round, with steel wire in the walls.

Name: Fridge Door
Inspect text: Metal skin, plastic lining, foam in between.

Name: Aerosol Can
Inspect text: Still hisses a little. Pressurised - don't crush it.

Name: Broken Toaster
Inspect text: Heating wires, a lever and a cracked plug.

Name: Dented Saucepan
Inspect text: A battered pan with a riveted handle. It clangs.
